Commands:\n create [options] Create a runnable eval suite from authored test\n cases (does
not run it)\n list [options] List the eval suites saved in a project\n runs [options] List a suite's run
history, newest first\n revisions [options] List a suite's settings history, newest first\n run [options] S
tart an eval run of an existing suite, or upload a\n versioned suite file and run it. The\n
upload-and-launch has a 120s deadline overall, not\n per request (raise it with the
global --timeout\n <ms>); --wait-timeout bounds the RUN instead.\n status [options] Get the
status and summary of an eval run\n stage-analytics [options] Read the user-value chain funnel for one run\n
(--run) or a suite's runs as a trend series\n (--suite)\n route-facts [options] Read t
he tool routes a run's trials took — which\n paths were used, and which expected tools were\n
missing or substituted\n server-facts [options] Read the server a run was taken against — tool\n
surface, catalog size, annotation coverage,\n tool-metadata signals, and what conn
ect and\n discovery observed\n description-experiment Propose, start, or read a two-arm tool-desc

ription
Usage: mcpjam cloud eval create [options]

Create a runnable eval suite from authored test cases (does not run it)

O
ptions:\n --project <id-or-name> Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently\n updated projec
t)\n --file <path> Path to a create-API JSON body (or - for stdin). A\n versioned suite fi
le belongs on `eval run --file`\n --json <json> Inline suite definition JSON (or @file, or - for\n
stdin)\n --name <name> Suite name (overrides the file)\n --model <model> Suite-level default mode
l (overrides the file)\n --provider <provider> Suite-level default provider (overrides the file;\n
needed for bare/custom model ids)\n --server <id-or-name...> Project HTTP server names or IDs (overrides the\n
file)\n --client <id-or-name...> Clients to attach the suite to, by name or ID\n (override
s the file). Without one the suite lists no\n client and `eval run --client` has nothing to select\n -
-host <id-or-name...> Deprecated alias for --client\n -h, --help display help for command\nUsage: mcpjam cloud

projects [options] [command]

Operate the MCP servers saved in your hosted MCPJam projects

Options:
 -h, --help

display help for command

Commands:
 list [options] List the projects you can access
 create [options] Cre
ate a hosted MCPJam project\n update [options] Update project metadata\n delete [options] Delete a project and its
project-owned resources\n capabilities [options] Show what you may do in a project: your role, which\n
betas the organization has, your plan's limits, and a\n can-block of booleans. Ask this before scripting
\n anything that authors, launches or publishes.\n servers [options] List and manage the servers s
aved in a project\n status [options] Health-check every server in a project (hosted doctor\n per
